changelog:
- Initial release of gantt-roadmap skill.
- Converts project plans and milestones into ready-to-render Mermaid Gantt charts with real dates.
- Supports exporting the timeline to calendar (.ics) and visual formats (PNG/SVG).
- Highlights critical path, dependencies, risks, and buffer notes in the output.
- Requires project phases, timing, dependencies, and milestones as inputs.
- Ensures quality and clarity by enforcing proper structure and date formatting.
